question: Apply 2D MDS (random_state=42) to a z-score standardized gene expression dataset with known experimental groups. Calculate the ratio of between-group to within-group Euclidean distances in the 2D embedding, and the stress value defined as sqrt(sum((d_orig - d_mds)^2) / sum(d_orig^2)) where d_orig are pairwise Euclidean distances in the standardized high-dimensional space and d_mds are pairwise distances in the 2D embedding.

expected_output.description: two labeled values: Stress and Between_Within_Ratio
